notices: Node 'scope' declared with at 30, which 31 has no member for; its values are the enum of its answer format, which 31 sends after its prompt.
nodes/plan_sections/plan_section.md, if: written so that the node runs only when deliverable plan applies, as 30 ran only what an applicable deliverable needed.
nodes/letter_decline_letter/decline_letter.md, if: written so that the node runs only when deliverable decline_letter applies, as 30 ran only what an applicable deliverable needed.
nodes/letter_information_request/information_request.md, if: written so that the node runs only when deliverable information_request applies, as 30 ran only what an applicable deliverable needed.
The signature is written through renderer 'signature_after_blank_line', which leaves it and the line before it out when the signature is blank, as specVersion 30 did.
Loop 'plan_sections' returns each item through the new node 'plan_section_stripped', which strips the item's text as specVersion 30 did.
Loop 'letter_decline_letter' returns each item through the new node 'decline_letter_stripped', which strips the item's text as specVersion 30 did.
Loop 'letter_information_request' returns each item through the new node 'information_request_stripped', which strips the item's text as specVersion 30 did.
Each deliverable is now delivered by pdf in a message of its own, where 30 sent one message for the job.

texts.explanation: sent-format: the format appended to the prompt is 30's as § 1.8 rewrites it: every property required, an optional one nullable, written in canonical order, with the descriptions 31 sends where 30's had none; or a classifier's answers sent as its format, where 30 listed them in its prompt's last line, which the migration drops (part 10 § 1.8 (every property required, an optional one nullable); R12 and #1508, comment 5, item 7, #3, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-25 (a format's description sent; a classifier's answers sent as its format); #1508, 2026-11-26, item 7 (30's answer line dropped); part 10 § 3.2)

loop-item-strip-node: a loop whose .content is read returns each item through a node the migration wrote, which strips the item's text as 30 trimmed it: that node's text is 31's alone, and it is the item's text trimmed (#1509, comment 7207709261, item 1, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-27 (a rendered node for each such loop's ret strips each item); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)
